This profile configures the MoonWitness Engineer role for GitHub Copilot. The repository-wide, tool-neutral policy lives in the root `AGENTS.md`; follow it as the source of truth.

For Copilot workflow integration, load the `github-issues` skill before coding and follow `moonwitness-development`. For UI files, the matching instruction file points back to the UI policy in `AGENTS.md`.
